\section{\mintinline{./sc_lexer.py:SuperColliderLexer}{md2tex} - a CLI to convert Markdown to TeX}

\mintinline{./sc_lexer.py:SuperColliderLexer}{md2tex} is a simple but customizable markdown to TeX converter inspired by XSLT and functionnal programming. Rather than using fancy object oriented libraries, it locates elements of Markdown syntax using regular expressions and translates them into TeX syntax. It has only been tested with latin script so far.
